card.title: Make the Test Test You
card.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign up for the overnight shift if this project matters to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm keeping myself available for leadership decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I am much more decisive after breakfast. Could your commitment cover the night and mine start at eight?
